data.name: Persona Non Combata
data.detailed_description:
Players compete in the combat death sport known as PERSONA NON COMBATA, a live syndicated show broadcast across the outer worlds and far through the galaxy. Fight for raw cash prizes and lucrative sponsorships. Upgrade your team with the best weapons. Utilize the terminal to manage your team. Do what you can to win.

FIGHT AS A TEAM
Fight as your gladiators in high adrenaline battles, alone or with friends

USE AN ARSENAL
Utilize an array of varied weaponry and an gamut of useful devices

ASSEMBLE YOUR ROSTER
Recruit, train and fight as your roster of gladiators via the management layer

GO BIG OR GO HOME
Fight for lucrative contracts, sponsorships and payouts to upgrade your team

UPGRADE YOUR ROSTER
Enhance your gladiators with cybernetic augments via your corporate benefactors or extra legal means

EVOLVED PLAYSTYLES
Gain experience in the arena and unlock powerful enhancements via the trait system

DEEP SIMULATION
Manage your gladiators as they become injured and stressed

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY
Experience procedurally generated enemy teams and worlds. No two runs, teams or corporations are totally alike!

Will your fortunes rise or fall?

data.short_description: PERSONA NON COMBATA is a sci-fi gladiator roguelite, set in a far future world. Players compete in a procedurally generated gameshow for rewards and fame, managing their team of gladiators alone or with friends. Will you rise to glory or end up lost in the arena?
